item.title: City Library: Opening Hours
item.summary: A notice gives the library's opening hours, its rules and how to get a free library card.
item.content_markdown:
## Welcome to the City Library!

**Opening hours**

- Monday to Friday: 9 am to 7 pm
- Saturday: 10 am to 4 pm
- Sunday: closed

**Library rules**

- Please be quiet in the reading room.
- You can drink water, but you can't eat here.
- Please turn off the sound on your phone.

**A free library card**

The library card is free. Bring your passport or ID card to the front desk. With a card, you can take three books home for two weeks.

There is free Wi-Fi on every floor. The children's room is on the first floor. There are English books on the second floor.
